## Before you start

- **Designed for:** learners who can write small Python programs and want to
  turn them into reliable applications.
- **You are ready when:** you can use conditions, loops, collections, functions,
  imports, and tracebacks without needing those ideas retaught.
- **Practice setup:** use the generated Colab notebooks for most examples. A
  local Python environment and terminal are recommended for environments,
  packages, pre-commit, and command-line projects.

## What you will be able to do

- read and validate text, CSV, and JSON data;
- organize modules, packages, environments, dependencies, and project layouts;
- build command-line programs;
- test with pytest and automate formatting, linting, typing, and CI;
- use classes and dataclasses when they make a design clearer;
- deliver a tested application with useful documentation.
